description: Source code for the 'closed_rx_window_handler' class, managing reception window events, processing uplink and PRACH contexts, and collecting metrics in a radio communication system.

classes.name: closed_rx_window_handler
classes.description: Handles reception window events, manages context processing, and metrics collection for a specific sector.

methods.name: closed_rx_window_handler::on_new_symbol
methods.description: Processes a new symbol event, dispatches context checks asynchronously, and logs failures.

methods.name: closed_rx_window_handler::collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and resets internal metrics counters related to missed contexts.

methods.name: closed_rx_window_handler::handle_uplink_context
methods.description: Handles uplink context for a given symbol point, notifies about missed uplink messages, and updates metrics.

methods.name: closed_rx_window_handler::handle_prach_context
methods.description: Handles PRACH context for a given symbol point, notifies about missed PRACH messages, and updates metrics.
